licences.phpcsutils: LGPL-3.0-or-later (used as a library only, unmodified)
licences.phpcsextra: LGPL-3.0-or-later (used as a library only, unmodified)
licences.wordpress-stubs: MIT (stubs generated from GPL-2.0-or-later WordPress; run-time tooling only, nothing is bundled into the theme)

install.command: composer require --no-plugins squizlabs/php_codesniffer:3.13.6 wp-coding-standards/wpcs:3.4.1 php-stubs/wordpress-stubs:6.9.1 phpcsstandards/phpcsutils:1.2.3 phpcsstandards/phpcsextra:1.5.1 && curl -sSLo phpstan.phar https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phpstan/phpstan/2.3.4/phpstan.phar && vendor/bin/phpcs --config-set installed_paths <abs>/vendor/wp-coding-standards/wpcs,<abs>/vendor/phpcsstandards/phpcsutils,<abs>/vendor/phpcsstandards/phpcsextra
install.size_note: vendor 32 MB (without composer .git caches) + phpstan.phar 30 MB. In this sandbox GitHub release/zipball downloads are blocked (HTTP 403), so composer fell back to git sources and the phar was fetched from the repository tree; on Windows the plain composer dist install works.
install.windows: yes: pure PHP (phar + composer packages); needs PHP >= 7.4 on PATH

fixtures: fixtures/03-php (KEY.json): 3 clean theme files, 3 seeded files with 5 defects D1..D5

candidate_default.config: phpstan level 5 + wordpress-stubs via scanFiles; phpcs --standard=WordPress

candidate_tuned.config: phpstan level 7 (level 8 gives the same result); phpcs ruleset WordPress-Extra, errors only (-n), FileName and LineLength excluded
candidate_tuned.false_positive_detail: clean/functions.php:58 'nexus_get_rating expects int, int|false given' because get_the_ID() may return false. Correct by the stubs, but noise for a theme (fixed with a cast or a check).

limits: phpstan level 5 (its 'sensible default') misses the null dereference D1; level >= 7 is needed, and that level starts to flag int|false returns from core functions on clean code.
First phpstan run ~7 s with a cold result cache; later runs ~4-5 s. phpcs < 1 s.
WPCS flags the missing nonce 4 times (once per $_POST access); the wrapper de-duplicates by sniff + file.
Line numbers: phpstan reports D2 one line before the seeded line (the return statement).
reason: Baseline finds 0/5. Default configs find 4/5 with 0 false positives in < 8 s; the tuned pair finds 5/5 with 1 benign false positive. Pure PHP, runs on Windows, no network at run time.
